a.name: Kennel ledger
a.description: The six as one ruled ledger read top to bottom: photo, name, sex, colour, delivery line, price and a brass Ask pill per line.
a.differs_from: One ruled column of line entries, not a grid of cards, framed by rules; the built puppy sections are three-up or two-up card grids or a rail on a band.

b.name: Family sheet
b.description: A sunk tray that opens with a section photo of Maggie and her puppies beside the question; under it, the six as prints.
b.differs_from: A section-level photo of the dam and litter (the built sections carry none) and a sunk inset tray; the prints are three-up like S1.

c.name: Litter wall
c.description: An edge-to-edge photo mosaic, Cheryl on a double square; a bone plate in each tile's corner names, prices and links the puppy.
c.differs_from: A full-bleed mosaic of mixed tile sizes with 2px seams, not an even card grid on the page or a rail on a band; no section photo.
